name: Recomaze: AEO, GEO & AI Search Optimization for WooCommerce
author: betterrecomaze

sections.description:
Recomaze is an AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) plugin for WooCommerce. It makes a WooCommerce store readable by AI assistants and AI search engines, so the store’s products, policies and expertise can be retrieved, cited and recommended when a shopper asks an AI where to buy something. It also runs an AI shopping assistant on the storefront that answers those questions on the store’s own pages.

Traditional SEO optimizes for a page of ten blue links. AEO and GEO optimize for a single generated answer. When a shopper asks “what is the best waterproof hiking jacket under $200”, an AI assistant reads a handful of sources and names a few products. Recomaze exists to make a WooCommerce store one of those sources.

What Recomaze does

  • AI visibility tracking – track the buying questions that matter in a niche and see, week over week, whether AI assistants mention the store, a competitor, or nobody.
  • Answer-ready product content – rewrite product titles, descriptions and Q&A snippets so an AI can extract a clear, factual answer instead of guessing from marketing copy.
  • llms.txt – publish a machine-readable summary of the store at /llms.txt and /llm.txt, the emerging convention for telling AI crawlers what a site is and what it sells.
  • Structured data for answers – publish Article and FAQPage JSON-LD on generated content, so answer engines can lift a question and its answer directly.
  • AEO content generation – generate and publish articles that answer the exact questions shoppers ask AI, straight into WordPress posts.
  • Competitor tracking – see which stores AI recommends instead, and on which questions.
  • AI shopping assistant – a chat agent on the storefront that answers product questions in the store’s own voice, recommends the right item, and hands the shopper to checkout.
  • Personalized recommendations – real-time product recommendations based on shopper intent and behavior.

Where the store can appear

Recomaze prepares content for the assistants and answer surfaces shoppers actually use, including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Microsoft Copilot, and AI-powered shopping and comparison tools. These are independent services; Recomaze is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of them, and no plugin can guarantee a mention in a generated answer. What Recomaze does is remove the reasons a store gets skipped: thin product data, no machine-readable summary, no structured answers, no content addressing the question.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin, then connect the store to Recomaze from the WordPress admin.
  2. Recomaze reads the catalog and builds a Company ID: what the store sells, who it sells to, how it talks.
  3. It scans AI assistants for the buying questions in the niche and reports where the store stands.
  4. It fixes what it can – titles, descriptions, Q&A, llms.txt, schema – and drafts content for the gaps.
  5. The AI shopping assistant goes live on the storefront, answering shoppers and recommending products.

Who it is for

WooCommerce stores that already rank in Google and are starting to lose that traffic to AI answers; stores with large catalogs where writing answer-ready copy by hand is not realistic; and brands that want to know, factually, whether AI assistants recommend them or a competitor.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

  1. Recomaze API

    • Domain(s):
      • https://api.recomaze.ai
      • https://stagingapi.recomaze.ai (for testing and staging environments)
    • Purpose:
      The API is used to retrieve user-specific product recommendations, update user preferences, and refresh authentication tokens.
    • Data Sent:
      • Plugin token (used for authentication)
      • Store domain (to identify the WooCommerce store)
      • Interaction events such as user preferences or clicks
      • Product details from orders, including:
      • Product names
      • Product characteristics (e.g., categories, attributes)
      • Product prices
    • Terms of Use: https://recomaze.ai/tos/
    • Privacy Policy: https://recomaze.ai/privacy-policy/

  2. Recomaze Tracking UI

    • Domain(s):
      • https://trackui.recomaze.ai
      • https://stagingtrackui.recomaze.ai (for testing and staging environments)
    • Purpose:
      The tracking service is used to display UI components such as recommendation popups and gather anonymous usage metrics to optimize recommendations.
    • Data Sent:
      • Client ID associated with the WooCommerce store.

  3. Recomaze Admin Service

    • Domain(s):
      • https://admin.recomaze.ai
    • Purpose:
      This service is used to send logs for monitoring and debugging purposes.
    • Data Sent:
      • Plugin events and API interaction logs.

  4. Recomaze Collector Service

    • Domain(s):
      • https://collector.recomaze.ai
    • Purpose:
      The collector service is used to retrieve reports for analytics and recommendations.
    • Data Received:
      • Analytics reports and performance insights.
sections.installation:
From the WordPress admin

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New and search for “Recomaze”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open the Recomaze menu in the admin sidebar and follow the on-screen setup.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the recomaze-ai-personalization folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Recomaze menu in the admin sidebar and follow the on-screen setup.

WooCommerce must be installed and active before setup.
sections.faq:
What is AEO?

AEO stands for Answer Engine Optimization: optimizing a site so AI assistants and answer engines can retrieve, understand and cite it when they generate an answer, instead of optimizing only for a ranked list of links.

What is GEO?

GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. It is used interchangeably with AEO and refers to the same goal: being the source a generative AI uses to build its answer.

How is AEO different from SEO?

SEO competes for a position on a results page a shopper still has to click through. AEO competes to be inside the answer itself. A page can rank well in Google and still never be quoted by an AI assistant, usually because its content cannot be parsed into a clear factual claim.

How do I get my products recommended by ChatGPT?

An AI assistant recommends what it can retrieve and verify. In practice that means product pages that state facts plainly, a machine-readable summary of the store, structured data an assistant can lift, and content that answers the question being asked. Recomaze automates all four for WooCommerce and then tracks whether the mentions actually appear.

What is llms.txt and does this plugin create one?

llms.txt is a plain-text file at the root of a site that tells AI crawlers what the site is, what it offers and where the important content lives – the same idea as robots.txt, aimed at language models. Recomaze generates and serves it automatically at /llms.txt and /llm.txt; no manual file is needed.

Does this plugin add schema markup?

Yes. Content generated by Recomaze is published with Article and FAQPage JSON-LD in the page head, so answer engines can extract a question and its answer directly.

Can I see whether AI assistants mention my store?

Yes. Recomaze tracks a set of buying questions for the niche, records which brands are named in the answers, and reports the store’s share of those mentions over time, alongside the competitors that take the rest.

Does it add a chatbot to my storefront?

Yes. The AI shopping assistant answers product questions on the store’s own pages, using the store’s catalog and knowledge base rather than generic answers, and recommends products in the flow of the conversation.

Do I need WooCommerce to use this plugin?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Does it work with my SEO plugin?

Yes. Recomaze targets AI answer surfaces and does not manage titles, meta descriptions or sitemaps, so it runs alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO and similar plugins without conflicting with them.

Is there a free version?

Yes. The plugin includes a free tier with the AI discoverability audit, an action plan and a monthly credit allowance, with paid plans for larger catalogs and higher volumes.

What data is shared with external services?

The plugin shares store domain, product details, and interaction events with the Recomaze API. The External Services section above lists every service, what is sent, and why.
